description.value: Ryuu Izakaya, marketed on its own website as Ryuu Japanese Kitchen, is a Japanese restaurant operated by Neptune Group in Richmond's YVR outlet retail area near the airport. It is part of a well-established Greater Vancouver multi-brand restaurant group and serves Japanese cuisine including food party trays. Cyclists exploring the Richmond dyke routes or the Sea Island area would find this a convenient sit-down or takeout stop in a commercial hub just off the cycling network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Neptune Group website confirms Ryuu Japanese Kitchen (YVR Outlet) is an active restaurant at 7899 Templeton Station Road in Richmond, with phone 604-248-8989 sourced from the website; the /ryuu-yvr subpage lists DoorDash and Uber Eats delivery options confirming takeout capability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content. However, the OSM unit number (1202) conflicts with both values shown on the website (67A on the main location page; 64A on /ryuu-yvr), and the OSM name 'Ryuu Izakaya' differs from the website's consistent use of 'Ryuu Japanese Kitchen'.
concerns: Unit number mismatch: OSM addr:unit is 1202, but the website's main location page shows 67A and the /ryuu-yvr subpage shows 64A — the correct unit is unclear and the website is internally inconsistent.
Name mismatch: OSM primary name is 'Ryuu Izakaya' but the website consistently uses 'Ryuu Japanese Kitchen' (which matches the OSM alt_name field).
OSM has no phone number; phone 604-248-8989 was sourced from the website only and could not be cross-checked against an OSM value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating Japanese restaurant with takeout, but the unit number in OSM (1202) contradicts both values on the website (67A and 64A), and the OSM name does not match the website name — address data should be resolved before listing. No bike-specific amenities are confirmed.
